entries.subject: ESA/Hubble heic1711a
entries.finding: The last of the Frontier Fields — Abell 370: Hubble ACS and WFC3, seven filters from 435 nm to 1.6 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 4164 × 4634 px over 2.08 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.03000 arcsec per pixel, north 27.9° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 39.9702863°, -1.5768308°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
